title: SIU identifies man shot by police
article: The Special Investigations Unit has released the identity of a man shot to death by police in a North York apartment building on Wednesday.

Police responded to a call concerning a domestic disturbance at 3640 Keele St. just before 9 a.m. During a confrontation between police and the man, one officer fired a shot which proved fatal to the victim.
The man has been identified as 37-year-old Cristian Iordache of Windsor. According to reports, the man had been involved in a struggle with his wife and had stabbed her in the neck with a fork.
Iordache's wife was treated for her injuries at Humber-Finch hospital and has subsequently been released.

The SIU is not releasing further details concerning the incident or results of Iordache's post-mortem while the investigation is ongoing. The organization is in the midst of an investigation, which will include forensic evidence and interviews with several witnesses.
